name: Well plug and abandonment technologies (thermite, bismuth plugs)
aliases: Well plug and abandonment technologies (thermite, bismuth plugs)
principle: Thermite heaters melt tubulars or a bismuth alloy so the metal re-solidifies as a gas-tight rock-to-rock barrier, run rigless on electric line. BiSN reports more than 500 deployments and 120 patents, including a 30-well Aker BP campaign; Interwell's RockSolid uses thermite for permanent abandonment, slot recovery and sustained-casing-pressure cures.

process_steps.name: Thermite reaction melts alloy or well elements
Alloy cools to a sealing plug; pressure test
